resources.string: Draws the VPN status dot and the remote-driven mouse cursor. Double-press Play toggles the mouse.
Mouse on. Clicks need Shizuku running

* needs Shizuku

Apps: filter, sort and search. Running apps show CPU and RAM; the header shows device totals.

Selected app: Details, Actions (launch, app info, view manifest, backup APK, enable or disable, clear data, uninstall, force stop), Permissions, VPN, services and activities. OK on an activity opens its options.

Advanced: every section collapses. Status, Network, Privacy, Screensaver / Appearance, Location, Mouse Toggle, Home redirect, Install APK and Diagnostics.

Home redirect: Home opens the launch app from the stock home. A second press during the delay stays on stock.

Widget: CPU and RAM for your launcher.
